name: ZDoom Vita
author: Mr. Azrael
description: Vibecoded port of ZDoom to the PSVITA, based on ZDoom v2.8.1 source code, with minor tweaks to the engine and a novel launcher to select WADs. Comes with Freedoom and the Doom 1 Shareware Episode bundled since both are freely redistributable. Has support for Hexen, Heretic, Strife, etc. as well.
